chapter_name: The Cap Seller and the Monkeys
learning_objective: 🎯 We will read a fun story about a smart cap seller and some naughty monkeys!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A cap seller was very tired. He had a basket full of colorful caps. He went to sleep under a big tree.
Many monkeys lived on the tree. They came down quietly. They wore all his beautiful caps and climbed back up!
The cap seller woke up and threw his own cap down. Monkeys love to copy! They threw their caps down too.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Copy Cat Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your mommy or daddy to do an action like clapping or jumping. You have to copy them exactly like the monkeys did!

quick_recap: ⭐ A tired cap seller slept under a tall tree.
⭐ Naughty monkeys took all his caps from the basket.
⭐ The smart cap seller tricked the monkeys to get his caps back.
